steps.why: An unattempted lifecycle clear on each valve. The non-hex valve's binding names a 16-hex EUI, so parseControl accepts it; push.js sendPreparedLifecycleClear's withValveWriter refuses the key and emitPendingClears goes on to the next candidate.
